structured.approach:
I followed the frontend-steps FE-04 procedure. I read the contracted inputs: task.components, feat.design, feat.stories, feat.screens, org.design_library, org.engineering_stack and org.lessons. I also read with the Read tool every repository file I cite: src/ap_portal/index.js, CLAUDE.md, package.json, ci.mjs, README.md and docs/ap_portal.md.

In src/ap_portal/index.js I implemented the components in task.components section 3.1 (items 1.1 to 1.9). The code follows the feat.design B4.2 algorithm and the feat.screens FS-1 and FS-2 markup. All changes are additive, and the existing functions are untouched. I documented the module in docs/ap_portal.md and updated README.md. I then ran `node ci.mjs`, `git status` and `git diff`.

CI measures coverage only from tests/*.test.js, and tests/ is outside this step's write scope. Coverage is therefore below the threshold until FE-05 adds the tests. task.code lists the exact tests FE-05 needs, and the gap is raised as an open question. No connectors and no secrets were used, and nothing was committed.
tools_used: Bash (node ci.mjs, git status, git diff)

claims.text: renderOverdueRisk was added to src/ap_portal/index.js and exported. It comes with the private helpers escapeHtml, toTwoDecimalString and riskClass and the constants RISK_CLASSES and OVERDUE_HEADINGS, placed as the design specifies.

renderOverdueRisk returns '' for undefined, null or an empty array, and throws TypeError when rows is not an array or a days value is not an integer. Otherwise it renders <table class="overdue-risk">, a header row with no class (Invoice, Vendor, Days overdue, Amount) and one tr with class risk-<risk> per row, in the order given.
Amounts are displayed with string operations only: a decimal-string regex check, then padEnd to two decimals. Number(), parseFloat and formatAmount are never used, in line with D-2026-044 and L-011.
id and vendor are HTML-escaped (&, <, >, ", '). The row class is allow-listed, so an unknown risk value renders risk-unknown.
LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary are unchanged, which keeps the rule to keep existing public signatures and add new functions for new behaviour.
VERSION in src/ap_portal/index.js moved from 2.3.0 to 2.4.0, a minor step. package.json still says 2.3.0 because it is outside this step's write scope.
After the changes, node ci.mjs reports compile true, 2 tests run, 0 failures, no static issues, line coverage of 61.02 and passed false. The uncovered lines are the bodies of the new functions.
CI measures coverage from tests/*.test.js and requires coverage >= 90, but this step may change only src/ap_portal/, docs/ and README.md.
docs/ap_portal.md was added: module overview, exports, signature, CT-1 inputs, outputs, TypeError cases, examples and private helpers. README.md now lists renderOverdueRisk and links to the docs.

open_questions: CQ-FE-5: CI line coverage is 61.02, below the required 90, after FE-04, because tests/ is outside this step's write scope. FE-05 must add the tests listed in task.code section 5 before FE-06 commits and pushes.
CQ-FE-4: package.json "version" (2.3.0) must move together with VERSION (2.4.0), but package.json is outside FE-04's write scope. Should FE-05 or FE-06 update it, or should the spine widen the scope?
CQ-FE-3: The Developer needs to confirm the version number 2.4.0.

Carried, non-blocking: CQ-FE-1 (who styles the risk-* classes), CQ-FE-2 (no approved Figma frames), RA-1 (branch name feature/story), and TQ-7, TQ-11, OQ-B8, TQ-6, OQ-B9, PQ-P7 and DQ-3, which are implemented on their interim designs.
structured.summary:
CI still fails for STORY-07 on ap_portal (branch feature/story): line coverage is 61.02 and the bar is 90. The new code has no tests yet because this step can't change tests/. FE-05 has to add them, and task.code.md lists exactly which ones.

The rest of CI passes: the code compiles, both existing tests pass and there are no static issues.

- **Code:** renderOverdueRisk and its private helpers are in src/ap_portal/index.js, built to feat.design B4 and the feat.screens FS-1/FS-2 markup. Amounts use string operations only, id and vendor are HTML-escaped, the risk class is allow-listed and no rows gives ''. The existing functions are unchanged.
- **Version:** VERSION is now 2.4.0, but package.json still says 2.3.0 because it's outside this step's scope.
- **Docs:** I added docs/ap_portal.md and updated README.md.

Every repository file cited was read in this run. Nothing was committed.
